purpose: P0.1/B02 baseline inventory; not a runtime tool schema or a certification list.

statusDefinitions.working: Verified for the explicitly stated scope; does not imply a complete game workflow.
statusDefinitions.partial: Implemented in part, with a concrete known limitation.
statusDefinitions.experimental: Source exists, but semantic and end-to-end behavior is not certified.
statusDefinitions.broken: A specific advertised outcome is contradicted by current implementation or a reproduced failure.
statusDefinitions.absent: Required functionality has no implementation in the inspected path.

methodology: Behavior union includes inspector catalog entries and literal b.type equality branches in both runtimes.
AI inventory includes literal executor switch cases and numbered system-prompt action declarations.
UI inventory includes every UI module and literal button/input/select/textarea/anchor opening tag. Dynamic IDs and templates are retained as patterns, not expanded instances.
Source scanners are conservative inventory aids, not JavaScript parsers. Computed dispatch, programmatic controls and semantic correctness require manual review.
Test mentions are literal name references only, not test execution, coverage or proof of gameplay.
Persistence is evaluated separately from source/runtime presence. No behavior is certified merely because generic properties serialize.
Explicit reviews override conservative experimental defaults. Runtime certification remains a P6/P7 task.

features.name: Scene hierarchy and transforms
features.editor: Selection, creation, parenting, transforms and gizmos exist.
features.persistence: World/local reconstruction and field completeness need repair.
features.export: Separate generated loader; parity unverified.
features.next: Round-trip nested transforms; validate parenting and undo.

features.name: Simple and Pro modes
features.editor: Inspector/mode controls exist; both still use the dense editor.
features.persistence: No project conversion is necessary; UI preference is separate.
features.export: Editor-only capability.
features.next: Build chat-and-preview Simple layout against the same project.

features.name: Complete project save/open
features.editor: Active-scene JSON export/import is wired.
features.persistence: Scene collection omitted; script registry exported but not restored.
features.export: Not an editable project package.
features.next: Versioned full-project format with round-trip fixtures.
features.proof: Previous targeted check reproduced one saved script becoming zero restored scripts; source still lacks script restoration.

features.name: Autosave and crash recovery
features.editor: No durable project recovery workflow found in inspected project/file paths.
features.persistence: No rolling project checkpoint store.
features.export: Not applicable.
features.next: Atomic saves, recovery snapshots, quota and interruption handling.

features.name: Multiple scenes
features.editor: In-memory create/switch/rename/duplicate/delete exists.
features.persistence: All scenes are not packaged by active-scene export.
features.export: Exporter reads active scene; full scene delivery unresolved.
features.next: Persist scene collection and verify transitions after restart/export.

features.name: Universal undo/redo
features.editor: Create/delete and some component edits use command history.
features.persistence: History is not a durable task journal.
features.export: Editor-only.
features.next: Awaited mixed-operation transactions and whole-prompt rollback.
features.proof: Source shows modify_entity mutating transforms directly; prior targeted check confirmed no added undo entry.

features.name: Isolated play sessions
features.editor: Play toggles behavior execution and UI.
features.persistence: No complete snapshot restoration in play/stop path.
features.export: Separate runtime implementation.
features.next: Clone/isolate runtime and restore editing state exactly.

features.name: GLB models and animation
features.editor: Bundled model catalog and GLB loading/animation setup exist.
features.persistence: Model URL reload and generated children need ownership/duplication tests.
features.export: Referenced paths and model resources need portable collection.
features.next: Reopen and export animated model with all textures offline.

features.name: PBR materials and texture maps
features.editor: Material editing and preview exist.
features.persistence: Selected fields/URLs serialize; full texture restoration incomplete.
features.export: Parity and resource packaging unverified.
features.next: Complete material/texture schema and dependency collection.

features.name: Procedural terrain
features.editor: Procedural mesh generator and terrain UI exist.
features.persistence: Generated mesh/generator state is not covered by complete project format.
features.export: Terrain survival needs actual exported runtime check.
features.next: Persist deterministic terrain data and test round-trip.

features.name: Reusable prefabs
features.editor: Prefab creation and instantiation exist.
features.persistence: Prefab map is not part of scene document; tree/reference completeness unverified.
features.export: Not a portable prefab project library.
features.next: Recursive instances, stable references and project persistence.

features.name: Physics and joints
features.editor: Component/constraint interfaces and custom helpers exist.
features.persistence: Box extents omitted; some joint data treated as virtual component.
features.export: Exporter loads Ammo externally; editor setup differs.
features.next: Explicit shared physics initialization and constraint scenarios.

features.name: Procedural SFX and spatial sound
features.editor: WAV generation, presets and sound tools exist.
features.persistence: Sound source/slot restoration not fully represented in scene schema.
features.export: Procedural runtime exists; imported sound portability needs verification.
features.next: Verify sound slots, browser audio unlock and asset persistence.

features.name: Custom script lifecycle
features.editor: Code editor, registry and attributes exist.
features.persistence: Saved scripts are not restored by current loader; bindings incomplete.
features.export: Runtime injects registered script code; isolation/parity not certified.
features.next: Restore scripts/bindings and isolate lifecycle execution.

features.name: Keyframe timeline
features.editor: Track recording/interpolation is held by timeline panel.
features.persistence: Panel tracks are not part of current scene document.
features.export: Timeline tracks are not a documented shared export contract.
features.next: Persist tracks and execute through shared runtime.

features.name: Visual flow graphs
features.editor: Node UI attaches graphData, but the inspected visual_flow_graph runtime branch only advances a timer.
features.persistence: Generic behavior properties can hold configuration, but it does not establish functioning graph logic.
features.export: Export branch also advances a timer; no node/edge event interpreter in this path.
features.next: Implement node/event execution or hide the blueprint claim; then certify save/open/export.
features.proof: Reviewed visual_flow_graph branches in editor and exporter; neither evaluates graphData nodes or edges.

features.name: Shader graph authoring
features.editor: Graph UI applies StandardMaterial from sidebar inputs.
features.persistence: No complete graph compilation/persistence contract.
features.export: No certified node-to-shader pipeline.
features.next: Compile node/edge semantics or relabel as material tool.

features.name: HUD and trigger systems
features.editor: HUD configuration and trigger registration exist.
features.persistence: Configuration serializes; stable-ID references and outcomes unverified.
features.export: Generated runtime has HUD/trigger paths.
features.next: Test objective, win/fail, restart and scene transitions.

features.name: AI scene copilot
features.editor: Provider client and real scene-action execution exist.
features.persistence: Chat history is not durable project/task memory.
features.export: Build results use the same unverified export path.
features.next: Scene context, typed validation, transactions and task runner.

features.name: Autonomous team workflow
features.editor: Keyword task decomposition, role display and structural inspection exist.
features.persistence: No durable finite complete-game task graph.
features.export: No required exported-game validation gate.
features.next: Persist planned tasks and verify/repair actual game outcomes.

features.name: AI skill consultation
features.editor: consult_skill appends a success-shaped result without reading content.
features.persistence: Static catalog exists separately.
features.export: Not a game runtime feature.
features.next: Return versioned skill text to the model through a real loader.

features.name: Portable game export
features.editor: HTML bundler exists.
features.persistence: Not an editable full-project format.
features.export: External engine/Ammo URLs; relative assets may remain.
features.next: Pinned shared runtime, complete dependency package and clean-target tests.

features.name: Public cloud publishing
features.editor: Creates a local blob and a public-looking URL.
features.persistence: No publishing ownership/revision store.
features.export: No upload request or real hosted artifact verification.
features.next: Implement hosting or present only local preview/download.

features.name: Desktop-only OS credential access
features.editor: Owning main frame and exact entry URL required; local HTTP endpoint removed.
features.persistence: Provider credential architecture remains separate future work.
features.export: OS credentials are not an export dependency.
features.next: Packaged Electron smoke test; complete P0.3 isolation work.
features.proof: Scoped security regression tests passed; working applies only to the completed access-control slice.

features.name: AI message rendering
features.editor: Response/action/team/audit/error text escaped before insertion.
features.persistence: Not a persistence feature.
features.export: Generated-game code isolation remains open.
features.next: Broader untrusted import/code isolation and CSP.
features.proof: Hostile strings exercised in actual rendering methods by regression tests; scope is text rendering only.

features.name: Desktop distribution
features.editor: Electron shell and Linux build configuration exist.
features.persistence: Desktop file adapter and recovery still need implementation.
features.export: Release artifacts are ignored generated output.
features.next: Clean install and packaged workflow support matrix.

features.name: Verified prompt-to-finished-game workflow
features.editor: No persisted completion contract/task runner with real playtest loop.
features.persistence: No restart/resume journal.
features.export: No mandatory clean exported-game test.
features.next: Implement P4–P6 after project/transaction/runtime foundations.
